invariants.rationale: writeClient is dereferenced for method calls and should not be null.
preppedRecordInputs is passed to a method expecting a List, so it should not be null at exit.
instantTime is passed to multiple methods; it should be non-null.
After commit, either the commit is in flight or already complete; this expresses that commit state.
If there is no input record, the output write status list should also be empty.
